metaTitle: Internal Controls and SOP Review for Finance Teams

overview: Weak controls are rarely malicious; they are usually undocumented. We map your key finance processes, write SOPs for approvals, payments and month-end, define an approval matrix and review segregation of duties with practical fixes.
